0.DSCR:
The pilot of Mazinger Z．
 He is a hot-blooded young man
with a strong sense of justice,
though simple-minded and a bit
careless． Entrusted with Mazinger
Z by his grandfather, Dr． Juzo
Kabuto, he went into battle to
crush the ambitions of the evil
scientist Dr． Hell, who sought
world domination．
 At first he had no idea how to
operate the robot and piloted it
recklessly, but the skills he had
honed riding motorcycles and his
natural talent for close combat
soon became second nature to him
in the cockpit． Those abilities
served him well in hand-to-hand
fighting against the Iron Mask
forces as well．
 After wiping out Dr． Hell's army
of Mechanical Beasts, he entrusted
the fight against the new threat
of the Mycenae Empire to Tetsuya
Tsurugi and Great Mazinger, and
left for the United States to
study abroad． However, as the
Mycenae Empire's assaults
intensified, he returned home for
a time and helped bring about the
enemy's defeat．
 After finishing his studies
abroad and returning to Japan, he
threw himself into the fight
against the Vega Star Alliance
alongside Duke Fleed, piloting the
TFO he had built himself and the
newly developed Double Spazer．

27.DSCR:
The emperor who rules the Hyakki
Empire, possessing powerful
telepathic abilities．
 The Hyakki Empire's goal is to
implant artificial horns that
serve as telepathic receiver
antennae into people's heads,
turning humanity into Hyakki
soldiers to use as pawns for world
conquest． But efficiently
developing Hyakki soldiers and
Hyakki mecha requires a Getter Ray
amplifier, and Burai has
relentlessly attacked the Saotome
Institute in order to obtain one．
 He possesses the ruthlessness,
cruelty, and majesty one would
expect from his demonic
appearance, exceeding even those
of Emperor Gore, ruler of the
Dinosaur Empire．
 Yet he can also show leniency
toward his subordinates． When he
learned that Hakkotsuki's daughter
Lisa had betrayed them, he honored
Hakkotsuki's plea not to have to
kill his own daughter and ordered
someone else to carry out the
execution instead． He also showed
consideration for Hidler, who had
just made a miraculous return from
the brink of death before the
final battle, by ordering him to
rest．

filtration and circulation system

assassination and executed his
father and colleagues in a coup．

Aphrodia's younger brother Milan,
and he and Aphrodia became bitter
enemies, each hating the other as
the one who took someone dear to
them．
 He boarded the Pulsarvern, a
subspace-capable spacecraft his
father had developed, and pursued
Gattler, but was caught up in the
warp of a subspace fortress and
crash-landed on the surface of the
moon． He was taken prisoner by
Blue Fixer while lying
unconscious． Because he holds an
intense longing for the nature
already lost on Planet S-１, when
he first saw Earth's oceans and
skies, their beauty moved him to
tears．
 He was originally an
approachable, cheerful, and
likeable young man, but the string
of misfortunes he suffered,
combined with the frustration of
not being trusted by those around
him, sometimes led him to lash out
at Blue Fixer members in fits of
rage．
 He later volunteered to join Blue
Fixer in order to defeat his
archenemy Gattler, and with the
birth of Baldios, he gradually
began to open his heart to his
fellow Blue Fixer members．

A special member of Blue Fixer's
Special Task Force, and the pilot
of the New Pulsarvern and
Baldios．
 Because he is an alien, he was at
first suspected of being a spy and
met with strong resistance within
the base． But through his own
actions he gradually won the
crew's trust, and his outstanding
piloting skill and knowledge of
subspace mechanics eventually
earned him the position of
Baldios's main pilot．
 He holds firmly to the belief
that whatever he judges to be
right must be carried out, and he
will rush to the aid of comrades
or loved ones in danger even at
the cost of violating orders． But
that conviction is a double-edged
sword that can also become a
liability - as shown when he was
prepared to kill Marie, the news
director of World Broadcasting, to
protect Baldios's secret when she
tried to uncover the truth about
the Blue Fixer base．
 At heart, though, he is a
pure-hearted young man who
secretly loves Earth's beauty even
more than Earth's own people do．
Precisely because of this, his
determination to defeat Gattler is
fierce, and his anger toward
Aldebaron, which seeks to engulf
Earth in war, burns like a raging
fire within him．
 He seems to be hopeless when it
comes to romance： when Jamie
invited him to a concert, he
showed up at the meeting place
with Raita and Oliver in tow, an
oblivious response that hurt her
feelings．
 Though he and Aphrodia remain
enemies, their exchanges through
battle seem to have struck a chord
somewhere in his heart．

radiation-contaminated planet．

emperor, who deferred to the
scientists working toward
restoring the environment, he used
the Aldebaron military to carry
out the emperor's assassination．
He then pinned the blame on Marin
and had the scientists, who stood
in his way, executed．
 After the coup succeeded, he
declared an evacuation from Planet

carrying out a warp to a new

 Though generous toward his own

Planet S-１ - and his iron will
never wavered to the end．

fortress for word of the
operation's success．

106.DSCR:
A Civilian boy who
single-mindedly pushes forward,
true to his own convictions． He
is １６ years old．
 He broke the 'Three-Day Law' set
down by the Innocents, which held
that any crime became void after
three days had passed, and kept
pursuing Timp, the man who killed
his parents． Along the way he met
Rag and the others, and the group
tried together to steal a Xabungle
they happened to spot． They
ultimately failed, but
circumstances afterward led him to
come aboard the Iron Gear．
 He is filled with a drive that
goes well beyond mere initiative,
and once he sets his mind on
something he pushes forward no
matter what． On the surface it
looks like nothing but
recklessness, but that very
attitude embodied the 'strong
Civilian' the Innocents had longed
for across generations． His
influence spread to others
dissatisfied with the status quo,
and he ultimately struck down
Cashim King, the root of all the
trouble．
 He is quite skilled at piloting
Walker Machines, and even taught
Blume and the others at one
point． That said, his teaching
covered only the basics - he seems
to have relied more on brute force
than fine technique to get through
most situations．
 With his round face, easygoing
manner, and rough, thoughtless
personality, he would not seem, by
ordinary standards, to be popular
with girls． And yet, perhaps
because he was unconventional in
every respect, he was quite
popular with the girls around
him．

211.DSCR:
Shinn Asuka is a mobile suit
pilot assigned to the Minerva． He
is １６ years old．
 Born and raised in Orb, he lived
peacefully with his family,
unaware of war． However, during
the Earth Alliance's invasion of
Orb in the previous war, he lost
both his parents and his younger
sister before his very eyes．
Shortly thereafter, at Todaka's
suggestion, he relocated to PLANT,
and, believing that 'power is
necessary to protect what is
precious,' he joined ZAFT． He
graduated from the academy with
excellent records and rose to wear
the red uniform, the mark of an
elite pilot． Given this
background, while his nature is
cheerful, he has a very sensitive
side, and his aggression often
comes to the surface．
 His hidden potential was
recognized by Durandal, and he was
chosen as the pilot of the Impulse
Gundam, the latest mobile suit．
When the three Second Stage
Gundams were stolen, he sortied to
take them back． Initially, due to
a lack of combat experience, he
achieved little, but eventually,
his rejection of the repeated
battles and deaths caused him to
awaken SEED． From then on, he
fought with unparalleled vigor and
grew into a top ace． While he
respected Athrun, he often vented
his anger at Athrun's indecisive
attitude．
 His chance encounter with Stella,
and their reunion amid battle, led
him to see the shadow of his
younger sister in her． When
Stella was taken prisoner, he
risked his own life to let her
escape, but even so, she could not
be saved from her cruel fate．

252.DSCR:

quite ordinary except for being
good at games． Seventeen years
old． His parents were killed by
Exodusists, so he despises the
Exodus, and, carrying that
emotional wound, he became a
shut-in． While spending his days
absorbed in the online game
'Overman Battle,' he eventually
achieved ２００ consecutive wins
and obtained the champion title of
'King．' One day, in a prison
where he was held on false
charges, he met Gain and hitched
onto his escape． On the way, he
named the Overman he acquired
'King Gainer,' and showed off his
game champion skills against the
approaching Siberia Railway
guard． Then, almost without
meaning to, he took part in the
Exodus． Because of his past
experiences, he was initially
quite introverted． But while
various feelings - admiration for
and rebellion against Gain, his
feelings for Sara, and his own
sense of responsibility and
potential - swirled within him, he
kept fighting, and became a great
power in continuing the Exodus
under Yapan's ceiling． At the
same time, he grew as a person．

283.DSCR:
Roger Smith is the foremost
negotiator in Paradigm City, a
town that has lost its memories,
aged twenty-five． He advances
negotiations with a humorous and
witty tone, delivering results
beyond what his clients expect．
He is fundamentally a feminist and
a gentleman, but he is quick to
lose his temper, and against those
who refuse to listen to his words
and break good faith and rules, he
may resort to force． However, he
makes it a principle never to
carry a gun, no matter how
dangerous the job． He has a past
as a former military police
lieutenant, and is an old
acquaintance of Dastun． He is a
stubborn man who dislikes bending
his own views, but when Dorothy
says she wants to keep a cat, he
ends up granting such earnest
wishes despite his grumbling,
showing a good-natured side． He
holds the memory of piloting Big
O, and with Big O confronts great
evils． This is by no means an act
of playing at being a hero, but
the result of straightforward
anger toward those who break good
faith and human rules． Roger
himself does not know why he holds
the memory to pilot Big O． He
makes his home in a ruined bank on
７２nd Street, Out of the Dome．
Because Roger has an extreme
preference for black, everyone
living in his mansion is required
to wear black clothing． Also,
only women may enter his mansion
unconditionally． His hobby is
collecting hourglasses, and he
also makes them himself． He
places great importance on a
refreshing awakening, though his
poor rising from sleep has seen
him roused by Dorothy's extreme
piano playing．

Kabuto．
 It is completed when Kouji's Hover Pilder, launched
from a sewage treatment plant with the shout "Mazin
Go!", combines with the head (Pilder On)．
 It runs on photon power, and boasts a jumping
ability of ２０ meters, a grip strength of １５０
tons, and ６５０,０００ horsepower． Its armor,
covered in Chogokin Z, is extremely sturdy, and
ordinary attacks cannot leave so much as a scratch
on it．
 It carries a variety of weapons, including the
'Rocket Punch,' which fires its arms via rocket
propulsion, the 'Breast Fire,' which emits thermal
energy from its chest plate, and the 'Rust
Hurricane,' which blasts a powerful acid-laden wind
from its mouth． But its arsenal did not stop there
- Professor Yumi and his colleagues went on to add
new weapons and enhance its performance again and
again．
 Among its many upgrades, the most famous is the
episode in which it overcame its greatest weakness,
its inability to fly, thanks to the 'Jet Scrander'
flight-assist device． This sequence of 'gaining
wings and flying freely through the sky' embodies a
longing humanity has held since the age of myth, and
it left an extremely strong impression． As a
result, many robot anime since have followed in its
footsteps in one form or another．

4.DSCR:
A giant robot built by the three doctors of the
Photon Lab after Boss pressured them into it．
 Perhaps because it was built from scrap, it seems
to be extremely fragile, and it is beaten to pieces
almost every time it fights． But it also seems easy
to repair for the same reason, and it was operated
solely by Boss and his two friends． Notably, only
its head was built to be sturdy, and it never broke
no matter what happened to it．
 After helping Mazinger Z destroy Dr． Hell's
forces, it joined Great Mazinger in standing against
the ambitions of the Mycenae Empire．
 At first it fought using nothing but the raw
strength that had let it hold its own against
Mechanical Beasts, but this proved useless against
the Battle Beasts． To compensate, Boss and his
friends developed a variety of weapons and finishing
moves through trial and error, contributing to the
fight with attacks such as the 'Drill Pressure
Punch,' built for them by the American-trained Dr．
Tobita, as well as the 'Boroboro Kick' and the
'Borot Spin Kick．'
 Boss Borot is also the only robot to appear in all
three of the original TV series． It even had a
spin-off manga serialized in a children's magazine,
leaving no doubt that it made a memorable impression
in a very different way from the lead robots．

３０% the speed of light, and within subspace, at
infinite speed．

the crystal on its forehead, the 'Pulse Saber,' a
sword stored in a chest component, and the 'Thunder
Flash,' which fires intense plasma from its chest．

143.DSCR:
A mobile suit that emerged from the White Doll, an
object enshrined at the foot of Mountain Cycle in
the Ingressa territory of Vicinity．
 At first it had almost no armaments, fighting in
melee with its bare hands or a beam saber． Later, a
rifle, shield, hammer, and other equipment were
excavated, and equipping these steadily improved its
combat power．
 It operates via the I Field Beam Drive (IFBD),
which spreads an internally generated I Field across
the airframe's surface and controls the machine by
manipulating it． Since it carries no generator, its
internal structure has ample room to spare, and the
Multi-Purpose Silo (a general-purpose weapons cache)
installed in its chest can be loaded with a variety
of armaments as needed． Loran in fact used it to
carry all manner of things, from nuclear missiles to
cattle．
 Its nanomachine-coated armor has self-repair
capability, and given enough time it can even
regenerate missing parts．
 The Moonlight Butterfly (M-Fly) system, arguably
Turn A Gundam's greatest feature, scatters
nanomachines carried on an I Field, and is said to
have destroyed the scientific civilization of the
previous century．
 The cockpit in the waist can separate and transform
into the Core Fighter． It has almost no combat
power of its own, but it is an indispensable part
for properly using the Moonlight Butterfly system．
 Only a few characters in the story call it "Gundam"
- Loran and most others instead call it the 'White
Doll' or the 'White Beard．'

264.DSCR:
Twelve thousand years ago, Apollonius created it as
a mechanical angel to fight the Shadow Angels． It
is sometimes called the Mythical-type Aquarion．
 By combining three Vector Machines, it can
transform into three different forms． The order of
combination greatly changes the resulting form's
abilities． This form is completed when Vector Sol
forms the upper body, Vector Mars the lower body,
and Vector Luna the back unit - it is Aquarion's
strongest form．
 It is characterized by a red-based color scheme and
a head modeled after the sun, with power stones on
both shoulders and shins that amplify bio-energy and
higher-dimensional quantum force．
 While it boasts armor resistant to physical attacks
and tremendous output, it also demands immense
Element ability from its pilot, making it a form
used almost exclusively by Apollo． Deploying the
Solar Wings on its back allows it to unleash even
greater power．
 Its main armament is its fist itself, and its
destructive power is strong enough to crush a
Cherubim Soldier in a single blow without even using
a named technique． Most of its finishing moves are
also fist-based, such as the life-risking punch that
reaches the moon, 'Infinite Punch,' and 'United
Light and Shadow Fist,' unleashed in perfect unison
by Apollo and Silvia after they finally recognized
their true feelings for one another．
 Note that when Lena serves as the main pilot, it
instead takes on the silver-gleaming form 'Silver
Aquarion．'

The doctrine that by moving the foundations of
their lives into space, humankind can attain the
'Newtype' - a new innovation of the species
adapted to space．
 Advocated by Zeon Zum Deikun, this thinking
spread widely among the Spacenoids who resented
the Earth Federation government． Zeon then had
Side ３ declare independence as the Republic of
Zeon in order to put Contolism into practice．
 But as it merged with 'Elezm', which held that
humans should live in space and revere Earth as

colonies should be recognized as nations Side by
Side, it drew still greater resentment from the
Earthnoids living on Earth． The pressure on the
Spacenoids grew harsher as a result, and the two
came to stand on the brink of open conflict．
 Even so, Zeon sought a settlement through
dialogue with the Federation government - only
to die with his work half done． After his death
the Zabi family twisted Contolism into the claim
that 'the Spacenoids are the chosen people',
renamed it 'Zeonism', and used it in the One
Year War that broke out against the Earth
Federation．

17.DSCR:

were adjusted at the fertilized egg stage to
grant them heightened intelligence and a robust
body． Their existence became known to the world
in C．E． １５, when George Glenn, the First
Coordinator, made a worldwide confession
broadcast．
 Coordinators are born with many superior
traits, both physical and mental． However,
whether or not those abilities blossom depends
heavily on the environment in which they are
raised．
 Most Coordinators live on the PLANTs, though
there are exceptional places, such as the
neutral nation of Orb or lunar cities, where
they coexist with Naturals (ordinary humans who
have not undergone genetic adjustment)．
 Those born to Natural parents through genetic
adjustment are called 'First-Generation
Coordinators,' while children born between two
Coordinators are called 'Second-Generation
Coordinators．' However, the birth rate has been

18.DSCR:

extremism． All of its members are Naturals, and
under the slogan "For a Pure and Blue World," it
seeks the eradication of Coordinators． Even
among Naturals who have not joined Blue Cosmos,
many regard Coordinators with suspicion - a
result of the organization's manipulation of
public opinion．
 However, the political front is only a facade．
Behind the scenes, Blue Cosmos hides its true
nature as a secret society acting as the hands
and feet of LOGOS in pursuit of the total
eradication of Coordinators． This is possible
because its members have infiltrated deep into
the core of the Earth Alliance and the Earth
Alliance Forces．
 After its leader Muruta Azrael died in the
Second Battle of Jachin Due in C．E． ７１, the
organization kept a low profile for a time． But
once Lord Djibril took over as its new leader,
it once again began manipulating public opinion
through the Atlantic Federation and the media,
working to drag the Earth Alliance and the
PLANTs back into war．

 Since it possesses no military force of its

33.DSCR:
Rau Le Creuset． A capable ZAFT commander． In
truth he was a Natural, but he concealed this
fact when he enlisted with ZAFT．
 He was born as a clone of Al Da Flaga, Mwu's
father, but because his telomeres, which govern
lifespan, were shorter than those of an ordinary
person, he was treated as a defective product．
 Learning this truth, he came to hate the very
world that had produced a being like himself．
He eventually leaked operational details and
handed over military secrets in an attempt to
bring about the mutual destruction of both ZAFT
and the Alliance． As a result, his scheme had
very nearly succeeded by the time of the Second
Battle of Jachin Due． However, he was defeated
in battle against the Freedom, and vanished
cursing the world into the light of the runaway
GENESIS．
 Perhaps because of a special drug he took
regularly to slow his aging, he was occasionally
seen suffering from side effects． It is thought
that he always hid his face behind a mask to
conceal features aged beyond his years, along
with the dark ambition he kept hidden within．

to their destination．
